The '''Intimidator PC2''',<ref name="TotJC" /> also known as the '''PC2 pulse wave light cannon'''<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|109|Intimidator (2)}}</ref> was a [[pulse-wave cannon]] manufactured by [[Greff-Timms Industrial/Legends|Greff-Timms Industrial]]. A two-man weapon, it cost 7,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], had an ammunition capacity of 100 shots, and a range of 300 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="TotJC" />
